verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents 700+ pre-built maintained connectors spanning SaaS apps, databases, event streams, and files (docs-1, docs-24, docs-54), with per-connector feature docs (e.g., Akamai, ClickUp) showing ongoing maintenance of sync/schema/delete handling, and independent community corroboration calling it 'no one has as complete a catalog of integration plugs as Fivetran' (fivetran-comm-19). A Connector SDK also covers long-tail/custom sources not in the catalog. Missing for 10: no independent audit of connector freshness/maintenance cadence beyond vendor docs and a single community quote.
